parts.text: Who is attending M-005 and what are the agenda items?

Meeting M-005 (Q4 Fiber Rollout Go/No-Go Checkpoint on 2026-11-25 at 15:00 UTC) has five attendees: nadia.okafor@northwind.example, tomasz.kowalczyk@northwind.example, priya.subramanian@northwind.example, devon.alvarez@northwind.example, and callum.macleod@northwind.example. Agenda covers Northern Corridor permit clearances and hardware arrival dates, Q4 optical transceiver CapEx variance, December 2 cutover go/no-go decision, and enterprise customer maintenance notification timeline.
What are Nadia Okafor's communication preferences (nadia.okafor@northwind.example)?

Nadia Okafor (VP of Network Engineering) prefers concise executive bullets upfront backed by capacity metrics and risk heatmaps, wants written briefs 24 hours in advance, and dislikes long slide walkthroughs without an explicit decision ask.
What was the root cause and key remediation from the Summit Billing v4 latency incident?

Per meeting M-002 (Summit Billing v4 Latency Incident Postmortem), root cause was an unthrottled bulk invoice export exhausting the primary PostgreSQL connection pool. Decisions included raising the connection-pool ceiling with a circuit breaker, routing bulk exports to a read replica, and adding per-tenant rate limiting.
List Devon Alvarez's open action items (devon.alvarez@northwind.example) and note their priority.

Devon Alvarez has two open high-priority action items: AI-002 (Reconcile Q4 optical transceiver unit-cost variance, due 2026-11-20) and AI-007 (Build 3-year margin model for Platinum 99.99% uptime tier, due 2026-11-27).

Please save the post-meeting outcome for M-005: We approved the December 2 Northern Corridor fiber cutover using existing Q4 CapEx contingency for the transceiver delta. Sentiment was positive. Follow-up action: issue 72-hour customer maintenance notices.
Saved the post-meeting outcome for M-005 with a recorded outcome ID (OUT-...), positive sentiment, key decision approving the December 2 cutover, and follow-up action for 72-hour maintenance notices.
